title: Evidence-bounded comparison of zero-fit PyBaMM models on three public CALCE cells
scope: the frozen three-cell first-cycle CALCE comparison
limitations: Only three first-cycle public CALCE slices are included in this frozen court.
The Ramadass2004 parameter set is not calibrated to these cells.
All three models substantially overpredict absolute capacity in the source receipt.
The observed ordering is protocol- and dataset-bounded and is not evidence of universal model superiority.
This document is a generated projection of existing evidence, not an independent replication or ScientificPASS.
